descriptionMarkdown:
Any Near-Unique or Unique item is Signature Wargear. A character may benefit from no more than three Signature 
items at the same time. Additional Signature items may be carried, stored or entrusted to allies, but provide no 
mechanical benefit until exchanged during a long rest or suitable downtime. Rare and Exceptional items do not count 
unless their entry specifically says otherwise.
Relic and archeotech effects do not stack with another copy of the same named item. Relic weapons and armour are 
already exceptional objects and cannot receive additional weapon or armour modifications unless their entry explicitly 
allows it. Masterwork Traits may be part of a relic profile, but are not added automatically.
Burden is part of the item. A Burden can represent maintenance, legal ownership, factional obligation, dangerous 
provenance, rare ammunition or unwanted attention. The GM should use a Burden to create decisions and 
consequences, not to remove a hard-won reward without warning.
